Marvel Announces 'X-Men' Reboot Cast at D23 Fan Event

Disney announced the cast for its upcoming 'X-Men' reboot at the D23 fan event. Adam Driver is set to play Mister Sinister, and Inde Navarrette will portray Rogue. Other cast members revealed include Kit Connor and Christopher Abbott. The announcement was met with some fan complaints, according to Metro (UK). The event also saw the reveal of 'Frozen 3'.
